skill.name: whatsapp-number-onboarding
skill.description: Guides WhatsApp Cloud API number onboarding, account checks, webhook setup, registration, and troubleshooting. Distinguishes official documentation from field observations and unconfirmed explanations.
skill.summary: Connect WhatsApp Business numbers and diagnose registration, webhook, billing, and delivery problems.
skill.author: rabbitdesigns22

security_audit.summary: All 46 static matches are false positives involving Markdown, documentation links, configuration descriptions, and authorized account checks. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or host reconnaissance. Two semantic risks remain: account deletion without explicit consent safeguards and placing client assets in an agency portfolio to avoid onboarding blocks.

remediation.issue: Account deletion is prescribed before explicit owner approval and data preservation checks.
remediation.suggestion: Require informed owner approval, data preservation planning, and verification of supported migration or coexistence options before account deletion.

remediation.issue: The portfolio workaround can place client assets under agency control without explicit ownership safeguards.
remediation.suggestion: Require client authorization, explain control and billing implications, and use supported provider onboarding rather than routing around account review.

semantic_findings.title: Account Deletion Without Explicit Consent Safeguards
semantic_findings.description: The prerequisite says 'delete the WhatsApp account on that phone first'. It does not require informed owner approval or data preservation before deletion, risking data loss and service interruption.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The prerequisite and troubleshooting row explicitly prescribe deletion without a consent gate. Later last-resort guidance reduces, but does not resolve, this contradiction.

semantic_findings.title: Client Asset Control Risk in Portfolio Workaround
semantic_findings.description: For a client portfolio stuck in review, the skill recommends a working portfolio '(yours)' and says 'Avoid the share'. This can place client assets under agency control without explicit client authorization or an exit plan.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workaround explicitly changes the controlling portfolio to avoid review or sharing difficulties. No client consent requirement accompanies it; malicious intent is not established.

content.user_title: Connect WhatsApp Business Numbers to Cloud API
content.value_statement: WhatsApp onboarding can fail even when Meta shows a connected number. This skill provides ordered setup checks and troubleshooting guidance for registration, webhooks, and delivery.
actual_capabilities: Explains the differences between business portfolios, WhatsApp Business Accounts, phone number IDs, and Meta apps.
Provides an ordered checklist for account setup, permissions, environment configuration, webhook subscriptions, and number registration.
Specifies status and subscription checks to verify onboarding results.
Maps registration, billing, and message delivery errors to documented or field-observed troubleshooting steps.
Distinguishes official references, field observations, and unconfirmed explanations.
Identifies cross-client configuration mistakes and stale webhook domains.
limitations: Contains instructions only; account changes require suitable agent tools, authorized access, and human participation.
Does not provide a complete reference for sending messages, creating templates, or writing sales copy.
Cannot guarantee Meta approval, delivery, or current platform limits; some explanations are explicitly unconfirmed.
Deletion and agency-portfolio workarounds need additional owner consent, data preservation, and ownership safeguards.

use_cases.title: Prepare a first business number
use_cases.description: Organize required business information, account identifiers, registration steps, and final delivery checks before launch.

use_cases.title: Separate client integrations
use_cases.description: Review app ownership, hosting projects, webhook destinations, and account identifiers to prevent cross-client configuration mistakes.

use_cases.title: Diagnose missing or duplicate messages
use_cases.description: Compare number status, app subscriptions, callback domains, and error details before making disruptive changes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan initial onboarding
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a WhatsApp Cloud API onboarding checklist for my business. List required information and human actions. Do not request tokens or PINs in chat.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate missing messages
prompt_templates.prompt: Meta shows my number as connected, but incoming messages do not reach my bot. Suggest read-only checks first and distinguish field observations from official guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Review a deployment change
prompt_templates.prompt: Our WhatsApp bot stopped receiving messages after a hosting domain change. Review callback URLs, subscribed fields, app subscriptions, and project identity before proposing changes.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a client onboarding plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit our client onboarding plan for ownership, project isolation, token handling, registration limits, and delivery checks. Require approval before deletion, subscription removal, or portfolio changes.

output_examples.input: The number shows connected, but my webhook receives nothing.
output: Confirm the number's platform and status directly in Meta.
Inspect the configured callback URL, messages field subscription, and WABA app subscription.
Check app and WABA ownership; the same-portfolio recommendation is a field observation.
Send a controlled test message and inspect webhook delivery before changing account settings.

output_examples.input: Registration returned error 133016 after repeated activation attempts.
output: The skill associates this error with registration rate limits and a 72-hour block.
Check Meta's current registration documentation and returned details before scheduling another attempt.
Do not delete or move the number as a routine retry strategy.
Inspect Meta's returned error details instead of assuming a cause.
Review the WhatsApp account's payment method, credit line, timezone, currency, and suspension status.
Compare delivered and failed messages during the same period before describing the issue as account-wide.

best_practices: Confirm account ownership and the exact hosting project before changing identifiers or webhook settings.
Keep tokens and PINs out of chat; use secure storage and human entry for sensitive values.
Start with read-only checks and verify current Meta guidance; obtain owner approval before destructive or ownership-changing actions.
anti_patterns: Treating a valid token or a green dashboard as proof that messages reach the bot.
Repeatedly registering or deregistering a number while ignoring rate limits and returned error details.
Deleting accounts or placing client assets in an agency portfolio without informed approval and a continuity plan.

faq.question: Does this skill connect the number automatically?
faq.answer: It provides instructions. Execution depends on the agent's tools and permissions; humans still handle verification codes, PINs, secrets, identity checks, and payments.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The marketplace lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does a connected dashboard status prove delivery works?
faq.answer: No. The skill recommends checking number status, webhook settings, subscriptions, and a real incoming message.

faq.question: Are all troubleshooting recommendations official Meta policy?
faq.answer: No. The skill separates official references, field observations, and unconfirmed explanations. Verify current documentation before relying on platform limits or migration rules.

faq.question: Should I delete an existing WhatsApp account immediately?
faq.answer: No. Confirm supported migration options, preserve necessary data, and obtain informed owner approval before deletion.

faq.question: Should client assets use my agency's portfolio?
faq.answer: Not without explicit client authorization and clear control, billing, and exit arrangements. Prefer supported provider onboarding over workarounds for account review.
